CD_SECTOR_BYTES.description: Number of PCM bytes in a raw audio CD sector.

CD_LOOKUP_PORT.description: Service port: UDP for CD recognition requests and replies, TCP for hosted artwork.

CD_LOOKUP_PACKET_BYTES.description: Maximum encoded CD recognition request size in bytes.

CD_LOOKUP_TYPE.description: JSON type identifier for a CD table-of-contents request.

CD_LOOKUP_VERSION.description: Version of the CD table-of-contents request format.

CD_LOOKUP_REPLY_MAGIC.description: ASCII prefix identifying a CD metadata reply with an artwork state byte after the correlation token.

CD_LOOKUP_TOKEN_BYTES.description: Size of the reply correlation token in bytes; encoded as a big-endian unsigned 32-bit integer.

CD_SECTORS_PER_SECOND.description: Number of audio CD sectors per second, used to convert offsets to durations.

CD_LEAD_IN_SECTORS.description: Offset added to LBA positions to obtain absolute CD sector positions.

CD_MAX_TRACKS.description: Maximum number of tracks supported in an audio CD table of contents.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_STATE_BYTES.description: Size of the artwork state following the reply token; the shared metadata JSON follows this byte.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_PENDING.description: Artwork search or retry is pending. Continue metadata probes.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_AVAILABLE.description: The metadata contains a hosted artwork URL. Finish downloading before stopping probes.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_UNAVAILABLE.description: No artwork will be supplied for this lookup, including when artwork is disabled. Keep the placeholder and stop probes.

CD_LOOKUP_BUSY_MAGIC.description: Busy reply prefix; followed by the request token and a big-endian retry delay in milliseconds.

CD_LOOKUP_BUSY_REPLY_BYTES.description: Busy reply size: four-byte magic, four-byte request token, four-byte retry delay.

CD_LOOKUP_BUSY_RETRY_OFFSET.description: Offset of the big-endian retry delay in a busy reply.

CD_LOOKUP_BUSY_MIN_RETRY_MS.description: Minimum accepted delay before retrying a busy lookup service.

CD_LOOKUP_BUSY_MAX_RETRY_MS.description: Maximum accepted delay before retrying a busy lookup service.
